start.text: Check a Rito postbox for a letter.

letter.text:
Dear Link,
a storm took my lantern and my mast,
so I can't tell my tales on Windfall
this year. I enclose a notebook to keep
this tale in, and a sealed letter for my
old friend who keeps Windfall's light.

steps.text: Bring the storyteller's letter to his old friend who keeps Windfall's light.
sail_line: That sealed letter you carry is for the man
who keeps the light up on Windfall's windmill.
Let us not keep an old friend waiting, Link!

lines: A letter from my old friend? Thank you!
I'll keep a light burning for his tales.
He paid in stories; let me pay you in rupees.
